mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST declines > 10% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO declines > 2% QoQ, or Rank IC < 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises & PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) relative to GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS/GDPC1 is high, or Rank IC < 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances when INDPRO rises & UNRATE falls during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window.
